events.description: Monica Geller says Monica Geller is thanking Chandler Bing.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is asking what Bob looks like and whether Bob is tall or short.
Monica Geller says Joey Tribbiani has never met Bob.
Joey Tribbiani says Bob is something, trailing off before giving details.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Angela Delveccio, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing do not know what Bob is like and that Bob could be horribly something.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is planning to shut up now.
